themes.label: Scams, refunds and lost payments
themes.summary: Users report paying for orders that never shipped, cancelling and receiving only partial refunds, or being told money will not be returned. Several also describe slow or unhelpful customer service when trying to resolve these payment problems. One reviewer also reports being asked to create a new account despite already having one while checking an order.
themes.recommendation: Audit payment, cancellation and refund logs for iOS orders since v1.0.38 to find cases where charges were captured without fulfillment or partial refunds were issued, and add a support escalation path for unshipped order refund disputes.

themes.label: Accusations of exit scam
themes.summary: All four reviews on iOS version 1.0.26 accuse KakoBuy of being an exit scam that takes customers' money, with users warning others not to download or purchase from the app. Several reviewers urge people to file chargebacks for their purchases. The reviews give no specific transaction details, order failures, or refund experiences, so the underlying cause is unclear from this cluster alone.
themes.recommendation: Pull order, payment, and refund records for iOS v1.0.26 users from April to July 2024 to check for failed fulfilment, refund backlogs, or unauthorized charges, and have support reach out to affected customers to confirm the company's status and refund process.

themes.label: Expensive, slow shipping complaints
themes.summary: Users in this mixed cluster praise the item quality and low product prices but repeatedly say shipping is expensive and slow, with delivery times ranging from 11 days to 3 weeks. Several also report weak customer service, including slow replies and no refund after a payment failure, and one reviewer describes hidden shipping fees that exceeded the item price on iOS version 1.0.72.
themes.recommendation: Audit the checkout flow on iOS v1.0.72 to confirm all shipping fees, warehouse routing, and size selection are shown before payment, and add a per-item shipping cost breakdown plus a refund path for failed card payments.

themes.label: Users switching from PandaBuy
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster are short, enthusiastic comparisons praising KakoBuy (called HagoBuy in the reviews) as better than PandaBuy, with users citing cheaper items, cheaper shipping, and more coupons. Several users mention they are switching from PandaBuy after months of shipping frustration, and a few reference following a TikTok account for the app. One lower-rated review reports a wrong size shipped and a three-week shipping delay, and one 5-star review notes weak customer service despite overall praise.
themes.recommendation: Audit the shipping estimator and delivery tracking for iOS users, since one reviewer asks for a shipping estimator and another reports a three-week delay, and track whether shipping complaints rise as switchers arrive; separately, review size-selection and order-accuracy checks to prevent wrong-size fulfilment.

themes.label: App blocks user's card
themes.summary: A single iOS reviewer on version 1.0.72 says the KakoBuy app blocks their card, giving a 1-star rating. The review is very short, so it is unclear whether the app itself restricts card use, flags the card as fraudulent, or whether the user is confusing it with a bank-side block.
themes.recommendation: Pull logs and support tickets for iOS users on v1.0.72 mentioning card blocks or declines, and check whether any card-linked feature or fraud rule in that build could be triggering blocks on legitimate cards.

themes.label: Mixed unrelated feedback
themes.summary: This cluster groups reviews that do not share a single theme. Two 2023 iOS reviews on v1.0.0 are short praise, while the rest are recent 1-star reviews: one Android report on v1.5.6 says the app is not working, and two iOS reviews on v1.0.72 and v1.0.55 are mostly insults, with one describing being unable to log in. Only the login complaint points to a real issue, so the average rating and frequent terms are misleading.
themes.recommendation: Pull sign-in error logs and crash reports for iOS v1.0.72 and Android v1.5.6 from October 2026 to determine whether login failures are widespread, and tune the clustering so praise and abusive reviews are separated from genuine bug reports.

themes.label: Vague mixed feedback, no theme
themes.summary: This cluster contains only two very short Android reviews, one a 1-star "no good" and the other a 5-star "good" with no detail. The reviews are too sparse and contradictory to point to any specific issue, feature, or request, so no coherent theme can be drawn from them.
themes.recommendation: Do not prioritize this cluster on its own; instead, check whether the 1-star review from 2026-09-17 can be matched to a specific complaint in other reviews or support tickets from the same period, and consider adding an in-app prompt asking low-rated users what went wrong.

themes.label: Repeated shipping fee charges
themes.summary: This cluster is incoherent and likely grouped by surface-level similarity rather than a shared theme. One iOS reviewer on v1.0.38 says they paid shipping three times over more than a month and were told to keep paying, while the other, a 5/5 iOS review on v1.0.72, praises a sports jersey purchase and says it looked identical to cheaper alternatives.
themes.recommendation: Pull iOS order and payment logs for v1.0.38 to check for duplicate shipping charges and stalled orders, and confirm whether the shipping fee retry logic is charging customers repeatedly.

themes.label: Praise: short enthusiastic reviews
themes.summary: This cluster is almost entirely short, enthusiastic praise with no feature request or complaint, mostly emoji and slang like "fire" and "W". One review favorably compares KakoBuy to pandabuy, and the rest are too vague to point to a specific screen, platform, or version issue.
themes.recommendation: Treat this cluster as low-signal sentiment and do not open a ticket from it, but pull any reviews that name a competitor like pandabuy to see which features users are comparing favorably.

themes.label: Praise: enthusiasm for Hagobuy
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are short, enthusiastic five-star reviews praising Hagobuy and its sheet of replica ("rep") products, with one saying they will keep being a "rep demon". The reviews contain no feature requests or complaints, and the wording is mostly slang and shout-outs rather than specific functionality.
themes.recommendation: Protect this community sentiment by keeping the current catalog and spreadsheet experience stable, and review whether the "rep" terminology and shout-outs (such as the Instagram mention) are being used in the app store listing or community channels to amplify it.

themes.label: Praise: resale usefulness
themes.summary: A single Android user gives KakoBuy five stars and says the app is good for reselling. The review is very short and does not name a specific feature, screen, or version, so the cluster offers little detail beyond general approval.
themes.recommendation: Tag this review as praise for the resale use case and check whether other reviews mention reselling, so the team can see if sellers are a meaningful user segment worth protecting in future releases.

themes.label: Praise: short positive slang
themes.summary: A single Android reviewer gave KakoBuy 5 stars with the one word "goated", which is informal praise with no specific feature, complaint, or request mentioned. The cluster is too small and thin to reveal any broader theme.
themes.recommendation: Take no product action based on this review alone, but tag it as general praise so it can be counted in sentiment trends if more similar short positive reviews accumulate.
